sources.label: Community patches for various apps, compatible with Morphe. Improve privacy, cus
sources.author: PatchLab
patch_list: Stops the app's Firebase custom-event logging call. Other Firebase collection and other analytics SDKs may remain active.
Uses the live player's existing content-only route in place of its local IMA preroll. Ads already in the live stream can still play.
Keeps the original VOD media item instead of attaching the client-side ad configuration. Does not remove stitched server-side ads.
Loads the bundled Ditu logo animation in place of the remote full-screen startup video.
Disables the client forced-update decision while retaining optional update checks. Server-side version requirements can still apply.
Disables the player's optional Megaphone banner overlay on phone and TV. This can hide announcements as well as promotions.
Removes the Google advertising ID and Android Ad Services advertising ID permissions. Other identifiers and telemetry may remain.
